rendering_strategy.mobile_preview: Uses shared PhonePreviewFrame with camera frame outside the page route.
rendering_strategy.status_bar: Uses MobileStatusBar tone=light instead of custom per-page status chrome.

ignored_system_chrome.reason: OS gesture/navigation chrome, not product UI.
ignored_system_chrome.implementation: No DOM/CSS home-indicator node is rendered; the sheet keeps ordinary bottom content padding instead.

rendering_strategy.critical_styles: Stable .wedding-* selectors own root sizing, hero image, top controls, detail sheet, cards, CTA, and scrollbar hiding.

hero_sheet_overlap.implementation: Hero image extends behind the bottom detail sheet; the sheet owns z-index, top radius, fill, and top shadow.

generation_prompt_if_available.prompt: Create a clean mobile app hero photo of a romantic beach wedding venue at sunset, matching the reference composition: white drapes framing the scene, palm trees on both sides, floral wedding arch centered on the beach, ocean horizon, tables with white cloth and pale pink accents, lanterns in the sand, soft evening lighting. Remove all UI and device elements.
generation_prompt_if_available.not_used_reason: No callable built-in image generation tool was exposed to this session and CLI fallback had no OPENAI_API_KEY.
